items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: I remember Sister Kate. That same style.

ctx.x: What type of pieces were they playing? It wouldn't be Tiger Ragg and that?

No, these were the dance tunes, like Please, or Out of Nowhere, and the things that they did for dancing with that band, the fairly slow things or medium things. Yeah. But even the fast thing, well they did Sister Kate very quietly. I remember Sister Kate. That same style. Yeah, yeah. So relaxed. The band was so, and the thing, I'll never forget it, that several of us were standing near the door at the end of that evening, I guess that was the last evening of the last dance there, and the band, I guess Bunk was…
Did Bunk ever discuss with you at all about playing the last chorus louder, or coming down real soft before the last chorus, or anything like that?
